mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index (proxied by INDPRO) falls below 50 for two consecutive months, it signals a contraction in industrial activity that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 50 for 2 months but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (> 0.5pp in one month) signals a rapidly weakening labor market that will negatively impact consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 1 month but SPX 5-day forward returns are positive > 50% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI inflation rate exceeds 3% and the Fed funds rate is below 1%, it signals a high-inflation, low-rate environment that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 3% and FEDFUNDS < 1% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (proxied by HOUST) decline by > 10% year-over-year and the unemployment rate is rising, it signals a weakening consumer sector that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST YoY decline > 10% and UNRATE rising but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive > 50% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment (proxied by PAYEMS) grows by > 200,000 jobs per month for three consecutive months, it signals a tightening labor market that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS growth > 200k for 3 months but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the industrial production index (proxied by INDPRO) grows by > 5% year-over-year and the CPI inflation rate is below 2%, it signals a positive supply-side environment that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO YoY growth > 5% and CPIAUCSL < 2% but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the Fed funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 5% and rising by > 0.5pp per quarter, it signals a tightening monetary policy that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 5% and rising > 0.5pp per quarter but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time.
